scope: Native-mesh orthographic opening geometry and sampled solid rib/root sections only. Not resin anti-warp/strength validation, FEA, CFD, slicer support approval, hardware clearance or manufacturing certification.

method.geometry_source: Evaluated native base mesh; build reports are not measurement inputs
method.area: Union of clipped native triangle projections along Y; straight-through XZ aperture
method.free_span: Conservative X extent of each connected aperture; horizontal chord also measured
method.root_continuity: Three YZ solid sections across each nominal rib core

opening_reinforcement_record.scope: CAD shell webs shorten the unsupported opening edge; no resin strength, shrinkage or flow qualification.
